D2: Official website at https://alphaping.ch/vaults lists 4 live vaults with embedded Ethereum addresses in page URLs: Alpha WETH Core (0x47fe8ab9ee47dd65c24df52324181790b9f47efc), Alpha USDC Core V2 (0xf1ca44eea3a4effcb195a970a2f1d8553f76f9a1), Alpha USDC Enhanced V2 (0x951a9f4a2ce19b9dea6b37e691d076a345b6c0f8), Alpha LINK Enhanced V2 (0x610f5b68bd1eed68af649a3fd3dc2caa1ee4ae7e). D3: No audit links recorded in protocol context. Website mentions 'audited' contracts (about-us page snippet) but no audit firm, report URL, or date is linked from the website or governance page. Logged as D3 unknown.

D4: No GitHub repo recorded for AlphaPing in protocol context. The GitHub result 'sebidelamata/alpha-ping' is a separate unrelated social trading app, not AlphaPing the risk curator. DefiLlama TVL page references 'View code on GitHub' but no repo URL was confirmed. No deployment artifacts found.
D5: Protocol operates on Ethereum only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required.

D6: All 4 vaults are Morpho MetaMorpho ERC-4626 vault instances (not factories). No factory address controlled by AlphaPing was identified. Owner/curator/allocator role addresses for each vault were not resolved because DeFiPunkd API reads require pre-pinned addresses and direct Etherscan fetches were blocked.

D7: All 4 discovered addresses classified as role=vault (Morpho MetaMorpho ERC-4626); actor_class=unknown pending on-chain owner() reads. protocol_metadata.about: AlphaPing operates mandate-driven, non-custodial on-chain credit vaults as a curator on Morpho (Ethereum). Depositors supply assets (USDC, WETH, LINK) into ERC-4626 vaults that allocate exclusively into over-collateralized lending markets on Morpho Blue, with AlphaPing acting as the risk curator selecting eligible markets and collateral types. Vault mechanics enforce deterministic exit rules, isolated risk compartments per vault, and on-chain verifiable accounting; AlphaPing holds no custody and does not perform discretionary overrides. The protocol targets institutional allocators, funds, and family offices seeking mandate-constrained on-chain credit exposure.
